instruction: Open https://bn.wikipedia.org/. Run a full-text search (pages that contain the word, not the article with that title) for পদ্মা. Then, in the advanced search form (উন্নত অনুসন্ধান), under এতে অনুসন্ধান:, limit the search to the টেমপ্লেট namespace only: add টেমপ্লেট, remove (প্রধান), and add no other namespace. Submit the search with অনুসন্ধান. The evaluated endpoint is the correctly configured advanced search request; nothing needs to be edited or saved.
